data.content: Plan review APPROVED. It covers all four acceptance criteria and explicitly retains every legacy path, archive, generation, pack, and Git object. Security is fail-closed through a marker that binds ref roles and writer identity; activation is immutable-first with exact CAS; rollback never rewinds epochs. Maintainability stays within focused compaction modules, and the test plan includes schema/vector/pack/activation/rollback plus actual v0.17.6 legacy isolation and full sanity. Provider live enforcement remains a later leaf, so Wave 1 performs no provider mutation.
